## Summary

Cinder Lane Hardware Inc: power surge after a storm damaged a laptop and a phone at a conference venue in Bristol. The loss falls to be assessed under clause 4.9, which requires the equipment to have been connected through a surge protector. The file does not say whether it was, so coverage is not yet confirmed. The claim is neither accepted nor declined until that is established. Reserve 6,598 dollars.

## Facts

Cinder Lane Hardware Inc reported the loss on 11 March 2026 under policy CC-1592 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a conference venue in Bristol [notice of loss]. The loss is described as a power surge after a storm [notice of loss], [incident report]. The items are a laptop and a phone [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The incident was recorded on 13 March 2026 under reference IR/2026/4208 [incident report]. No third party was involved [incident report]. No theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report]. The file does not state whether the laptop and phone were connected through a surge protector [notice of loss], [incident report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss is a surge in the electrical supply damaging electronic equipment, which is the subject of clause 4.9. That clause covers damage to electronic equipment caused by a surge in the electrical supply, where the equipment was connected through a surge protector [policy]. The cause and the type of property fit clause 4.9 [incident report], [policy]. The condition that the equipment was connected through a surge protector is not addressed in any document in the file [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy]. Clause 4.9 cannot be applied to a conclusion until that fact is confirmed.

Clause 4.2 lists storm among its covered causes [policy]. The file describes the loss as a power surge, which clause 4.9 addresses specifically [incident report], [policy]. I have not treated clause 4.2 as a separate route to cover, and I flag the point for the reviewer.

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: no theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy]. Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: it operates only where theft is alleged, and none is [notice of loss], [incident report], [policy]. Exclusion 7.3 does not apply on the present file: the loss is described as a single event following a storm, and no gradual deterioration is recorded [incident report], [policy].

## Decision

Coverage under clause 4.9 is not yet established, because the surge protector condition is unconfirmed [policy]. No exclusion applies. The claim is held open. The insured should be asked to confirm whether the laptop and phone were connected through a surge protector at the time of the surge. If so, the claim is covered under clause 4.9. If not, the condition in clause 4.9 is not met, and the position under clause 4.2 should be reviewed before any decline.

## Reserve

The reserve is 6,598 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (3,892 dollars and 2,706 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No excess is shown in the file, so under clause 9.1 none applies [policy]. The reserve is held pending the coverage decision.
